select	a11.YEAR_ID  YEAR_ID,
	max(a12.YEAR_DESC)  YEAR_DESC,
	sum(a11.TOT_SLS_DLR)  WJXBFS1
from	(SELECT 2023 YEAR_ID, 1 CAT_ID, 10.5 TOT_SLS_DLR, 1 CUST_ID, CAST('2023-02-14' AS DATE) ORDER_DATE UNION ALL SELECT 2024, 1, 20.0, 2, CAST('2024-03-05' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 2024, 2, 5.25, 2, CAST('2024-07-19' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 2024, 2, 4.75, 3, CAST('2024-11-30' AS DATE))	a11
	join	(SELECT 2023 YEAR_ID, 'FY 2023' YEAR_DESC UNION ALL SELECT 2024, 'FY 2024')	a12

where	a11.YEAR_ID in (2023, 2024)
